command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 seimensch-vps 'set -u; echo ===IDENTITY===; hostname; whoami; date -u +%FT%TZ; echo ===TMUX===; tmux ls 2>/dev/null || true; echo ===OMEGA_PROCS===; pgrep -af "omega\.(supervisor|supervisor_outer|grid_runtime_v3|bridge_relay|spool_bridge_relay|spool_bridge_relay_parallel|outer_bridge_worker|telemetry_daemon|master_bridge)" || true; echo ===RUNTIME===; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime /workspace/oMEGA /workspace/omega_runtime/current; do [ -e "$p" ] && ls -ld "$p"; done; echo ===GIT===; for p in /workspace/oMEGA /workspace/omega_runtime/current; do if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then printf "repo=%s head=" "$p"; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$p" status --short --branch | head -20; fi; done; echo ===STATE===; for f in /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json /workspace/omega_runtime/state/RELAY_STATUS.json /workspace/omega_runtime/state/outer_bridge/OUTER_WORKER_STATUS.json; do if [ -r "$f" ]; then echo FILE:$f; cat "$f"; fi; done; echo ===DISK===; df -h /workspace 2>/dev/null || df -h /'
